name: _nav-controls.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_nav-controls.scss — nav right-side controls: the WebGL burger
//  canvas + CSS hamburger fallback, the always-visible mobile strip, and
//  the 4-column language-dialog variant shared with preferences.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — uses $_B_NAV defined there.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Nav layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A single menu for every breakpoint: logo on the left, burger on the right,
// everything else lives inside the fullscreen menu modal.

// ── Burger button (WebGL canvas) ──────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-canvas {
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: block;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// ── Burger button wrapper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

// ── Burger button fallback (CSS-based hamburger icon) ───────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-fallback {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  display: none;
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;

  &:before,
  &:after,
  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-line {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    width: var(--space-lg);
    height: var(--space-2xs);
    background: var(--text-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  // Make fallback distinct from animated version - simpler, cleaner lines
  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-line {
    height: var(--space-3xs);
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-wrap:has(.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-canvas.is-fallback) & {
    display: flex;
  }
}

// ── Burger strip (always visible) ───────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-mobile-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
}

// ── Language dialog variant (4-column option grid) ───────────────────────────
.pref-options--4 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

  @media (max-width: $bk-540) {
    // 540px
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

// Language dialog shell (shared with preferences modal).
.lang-dialog {
  max-width: to-rem(480);
}
